title: 王孝忠侨批
description: 这张1952年的侨批封面以“王孝忠先生收”标明收件人，地址指向澄海莲阳一带，左侧记有“外付港币参拾元”。姓名、地址与款项同列于一纸，体现了侨批既传递私人书信，也承担跨境汇款记录的双重功能。部分地址及经手人字迹仍待考证。
descriptionEn: Dated 1952, this qiaopi envelope is addressed to Wang Xiaozhong in the Lianyang area of Chenghai. It records a remittance of 30 Hong Kong dollars. The names, address and payment details reveal how qiaopi served as both personal correspondence and a means of transferring money between overseas Chinese communities and their hometowns. Some details of the address and the intermediary remain unclear.

title: 黄桂桐侨批
year: 1953年5月3日（封背日期戳） / 3 May 1953 (date stamp on reverse)
destination: 潮安县彩塘 / Caitang, Chao'an County
description: 这件侨批寄往潮安县彩塘一带，收件人为黄桂桐。左侧注明“外付港币伍拾元”，并记有星洲（今新加坡）的黄瑞祥。封面中央印有鹤纹图案，叠加红色印章。地址、姓名和款项同列于一纸，呈现了侨批兼具通信与汇款的特点。
descriptionEn: This qiaopi was addressed to Huang Guitong in Caitang, Chao'an County. The envelope records a remittance of 50 Hong Kong dollars and identifies Huang Ruixiang in Xingzhou (present-day Singapore). Its central panel features a decorative crane design overlaid with a red stamp. The combination of names, addresses and payment details illustrates how qiaopi served both as personal correspondence and a means of sending money home.

title: 侨批背面的印记
titleEn: Stamps on the Reverse of a Qiaopi
year: 1953年5月3日（封背日期戳） / 3 May 1953 (date stamp on reverse)
description: 这张侨批封背保留了1953年5月3日的红色日期戳，以及圆形印章、方形印章和蓝色手写记号。这些印记反映了侨批在邮寄与处理过程中留下的记录。纸张上的折痕与褪色痕迹，也见证了这份文书历经岁月的保存状态。
descriptionEn: The reverse of this qiaopi envelope bears a red date stamp from 3 May 1953, along with circular and rectangular stamps and a blue handwritten mark. These markings offer a glimpse into how qiaopi were handled and delivered. The folds and faded ink also reflect the document's age and preservation over time.

title: 陈君瑞《难》诗侨批
titleEn: Chen Junrui's Qiaopi: A Poem of Hardship
description: 这件侨批由旅居印度尼西亚的陈君瑞寄给潮汕家人，内附一首以“难”为题的七言绝句。诗中描绘了海外华人离乡谋生的艰辛，以及对故土的深切思念。信笺中央醒目的“难”字，与旁侧的思乡诗句相互呼应，道出了漂泊异乡的无奈。
descriptionEn: This qiaopi was sent by Chen Junrui, a Chinese migrant living in Indonesia, to his family in the Chaoshan region. It contains a four-line classical Chinese poem titled Hardship, expressing the difficulties of making a living overseas and the longing for home. The prominent character “难” (hardship), surrounded by verses of homesickness, captures the emotional struggles of life far from one's homeland.

title: 谢映韶致兄长家书
titleEn: Xie Yingshao's Letter to Her Brother
description: 1968年，谢映韶在学校考试期间写信给映达兄长。得知祖母身体欠安，她表达了远离故乡、无法侍奉长辈的愧疚，并劝家人及时请医诊治，不要轻信卜卦。信中还提及侄儿的照片与双亲的近况，在日常问候中流露出对家人的思念与牵挂。
descriptionEn: In 1968, Xie Yingshao wrote to her elder brother Yingda while preparing for school examinations. After learning that their grandmother was unwell, she expressed her guilt over being unable to care for her family from afar. She urged her brother to seek medical treatment rather than rely on fortune-telling. The letter also mentions photographs of her nephews and news of their parents, revealing her deep affection and longing for home.

title: 王希添收信封面
destination: 新加坡（据封面文字） / Singapore (as indicated on the envelope)
description: 封面中央写有“王希添君妥展”，意为请收信人亲自拆阅。左侧记有潮安的乡村地址及“王陈氏”，右侧“至叻”指向新加坡。几列毛笔字记录了收件人、地点与转递信息，呈现了潮汕家庭跨海通信的日常方式。
descriptionEn: The central inscription addresses Wang Xitian and respectfully asks him to open the letter personally. The left column records a village address in Chao'an and the name Wang Chenshi, while the phrase “至叻” refers to Singapore. These handwritten details reveal how families in the Chaoshan region maintained correspondence across the sea.

title: 致希添兄的家书
description: 这封家书以“希添吾兄”开篇，写信人提及收到来信及三十元银款，并交代家人的生活近况与日常事务。信中既有对钱款往来的说明，也包含对远方亲人的问候。密集的毛笔字与纸张上清晰的折痕，保留了当时家庭书信往来的生活气息。
descriptionEn: Beginning with the greeting “Dear Brother Xitian”, this handwritten letter discusses previous correspondence, a payment of 30 yuan in silver and updates on family life. Alongside practical matters concerning money and household affairs, the writer also conveys concern for relatives living far away. The closely written calligraphy and visible folds reflect the personal nature of family correspondence.

title: 陈妙芝女士侨批
destination: 潮安黄塘乡 / Huangtang Village, Chao'an
description: 这件侨批封面写有“陈妙芝女士拆”，收件地址指向潮安黄塘乡。左侧注明“外付国币叁万元”，记录了一笔三万元的汇款。纸面上保留着红紫色印迹及手写文字，展现了侨批兼具私人通信与资金汇付的功能，也反映了海外华人与家乡之间的经济联系。
descriptionEn: This qiaopi envelope is addressed to Ms Chen Miaozhi in Huangtang Village, Chao'an. The inscription on the left records a remittance of 30,000 yuan in historical Chinese national currency. The reddish-purple markings and handwritten details illustrate how qiaopi combined personal correspondence with money transfers, reflecting the financial connections between overseas Chinese communities and their hometowns.

title: 致双亲的家书
year: 乙巳年（公历年份不详） / Yisi Year (Gregorian year unknown)
description: 这封写给双亲的家书采用传统竖排毛笔书写。信中涉及家人的生活近况、亲属之间的问候及彼此的音讯，流露出对家中老少的牵挂。末尾可见“乙巳年”的纪年字样。信纸上的折痕、泛黄痕迹与红色印记，保留了这封私人书信历经岁月的痕迹。
descriptionEn: Written in traditional vertical calligraphy, this family letter is addressed to the writer's parents. It discusses family life, exchanges greetings and reflects concern for relatives of different generations. The closing includes the traditional cyclical year designation “Yisi”. The folds, yellowed paper and red markings preserve traces of the letter's history and the passage of time.

title: 杨海源染坊侨批
titleEn: Remittance Letter to Yang Haiyuan Dye Workshop
destination: 潮邑普桂都 / Puguidu, Chaoyi (historical place name)
description: 这张侨批封面中央以红底黑字写着“杨海源染坊收”，右侧记录了潮邑普桂都的转交地址，左侧则注明二十元款项及经手人姓名。醒目的红色中栏与三列毛笔文字，将收件地点、汇款金额和交付信息集中于一纸，展现了侨批在传统商业往来与跨境汇款中的作用。
descriptionEn: This qiaopi envelope is addressed to Yang Haiyuan Dye Workshop, with its name written in bold black calligraphy against a red background. The right column records a delivery address in Puguidu, Chaoyi, while the left notes a payment of 20 yuan and the names of those involved. Its distinctive three-column layout brings together delivery and payment details, illustrating the role of qiaopi in commercial correspondence and cross-border remittances.
